notes: Strain: summary says TOP10F', ch:strain and growth protocol say MG1655; both K-12, strain_name left out. Medium and temperature not given. 0 min samples taken at phage addition: treated as uninfected (treatment none), vector 0 min = control; 5 and 10 min = T4 infection, acute, mixed_organism true (T4 transcripts in the library). All samples arabinose-induced (vector included). Phase early_exponential kept (<= 30 min after OD 0.3).

growth_phase.q: E. coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 containing either pNW129 or pNW129-MotB were grown to early log phase (OD600 ~ 0.3)  then induced with 0.2% arabinose for 20 minutes. Phage T4 was added to the culture at MOI 10.

inducer_added.q: E. coli str. K-12 substr. MG1655 containing either pNW129 or pNW129-MotB were grown to early log phase (OD600 ~ 0.3)  then induced with 0.2% arabinose for 20 minutes. Phage T4 was added to the culture at MOI 10.

transcription_arrested.q: To determine the effect of the T4 MotB protein on E. coli  gene expression, RNAseq was performed for TOP10F' E. coli infected by T4 after producing T4 MotB for 20 minutes .

assay_class.q: Optimum fragmentation of the total RNA samples in this library was determined to be 3 min at 94C in FastAP buffer
